info.name: Marvel Superheroes & Missions API
info.description: Exhaustive Postman Collection for Marvel Mission Control REST API. Covers Authentication, Heroes CRUD, Missions CRUD, Target Locations, and explicit HTTP Status Code / Error Scenarios (401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden RBAC, 404 Not Found, 422 Unprocessable Content).
